artworks.title: The Shield of Achilles
artworks.description: Flaxman's outline of Hephaestus' cosmos-shield — the forged world Achilles wore when he returned to avenge Patroclus.

artworks.title: Achilles Dragging Hector's Body
artworks.description: Hayez's chariot round the wall — the outrage that would move Zeus to send Priam with ransom.

artworks.title: The Death of Hector
artworks.description: Rubens' spear at the throat — three times around Troy, and the shield of the city ash on the plain.
